THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Munasingha Kariyawasam Appuhamilage Don SomadasaGunawardana, Minister of Lands, hereby declare under Sub-section(1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land describedbelow is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under theprovisions of that Act.

An allotment of land in total extent of about of 0.0243 Hectare asdepicted in tracing bearing No. CO/DSO/2014/62 dated 16.06.2014prepared by the Surveyor - General, situated in the VillageMoratuwella in the Moratuwa Divisional Secretary Division inColombo District in the Western Province and bounded as follows.

1. Lot 'A' – Assmt. No. 2, (A Part) Main Street (Galle Road)– Extent: 0.0243 HectareNorth: Assmt. No. 2, Main Street (Galle Road) Hewa DewageSaiman Fernando (Balance portion of same land); East: Bolgoda River;South and West: Lot B.
M. K. A. D. S. Gunawardana,Minister of Lands.Ref. No.: 4-3/6/2014/HW/310.Ministry of Lands,'Mihikatha Medura',No. 1200/6, Land Secretariat,Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.21st April, 2015.
